item.title: Support for multilateralism, expanded trade, fight against unilateralism outcomes of BRICS summit: President
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian, reporting on his visit to India to attend the 18th BRICS Leaders’ Summit, has expressed hope that the grouping of 11 countries spanning four continents would work together to promote multilateralism and prevent the United States from realizing its sinister goals in the region and the world.

item.title: Projectile hits Iranian commercial vessel in Strait of Hormuz, killing one, injuring four
item.description: Qeshm, IRNA – An Iranian commercial container ship was hit by an unidentified projectile early Sunday near Hengam Island in the Strait of Hormuz, killing one crew member and injuring four others, according to the governor of Iran’s Qeshm Island.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86262425/Projectile-hits-Iranian-commercial-vessel-in-Strait-of-Hormuz

Qeshm, IRNA – An Iranian commercial container ship was hit by an unidentified projectile early Sunday near Hengam Island in the Strait of Hormuz, killing one crew member and injuring four others, according to the governor of Iran’s Qeshm Island.
